formProduit.erreurNomPrix: Name and unit price are required.

mouvement.avertissementTransfert: ⚠️ To move stock to another warehouse, don't use "Out" — use "Transfer between warehouses", which tracks the movement and requires a receipt confirmation on arrival.
mouvement.justificatifAideMouvement: supply note, photo of damaged goods, inventory sheet…
mouvement.erreurJustificatifObligatoire: A supporting document (photo or PDF) is required for any stock adjustment.
mouvement.erreurStockInsuffisant: Insufficient stock for this outgoing movement.
mouvement.erreurPlusieursDepots: Multiple warehouses exist — this selection feature is coming soon, contact an administrator.
mouvement.aideEndommage: Goods will be stored in a 'damaged' batch, sold last and shown in the stock detail.

transfert.creditApresReception: The destination warehouse's stock will only be credited once its manager confirms receipt.
transfert.erreurDepots: Select the source and destination warehouses.
transfert.erreurDepotsDifferents: The source and destination warehouses must be different.
transfert.erreurJustificatifObligatoire: A supporting document (photo or PDF) is required for any stock transfer.
transfert.erreurStockInsuffisant: Insufficient stock in the source warehouse.

reception.ecart: ⚠️ Discrepancy with the quantity sent ({{quantite}}) — the discrepancy will be logged.
reception.notePlaceholder: Reason for discrepancy, condition of goods…
reception.justificatifAideReception: photo of goods received, signed slip…
reception.erreurQuantite: Enter the quantity actually received (0 if nothing arrived).
reception.erreurJustificatifObligatoire: A supporting document (photo or PDF) is required to confirm receipt.

import.consigne: Download the template, fill it in keeping the column order, then import it.
import.erreurAucuneLigne: No valid rows (name and sale price are required).

inventaire.aide: Physically count each product in the chosen warehouse. Any differences found automatically adjust the theoretical stock, and a PDF report is generated.
inventaire.erreurAucuneLigne: Enter at least one counted quantity before confirming.

erreurJustificatif: The movement is saved, but the supporting document could not be uploaded. You can attach it from the Stock log.
erreurJustificatifEnvoi: The supporting document could not be uploaded: stock was NOT changed

resume.partiel: on products with a known purchase price

detail.alerteEndommage: {{n}} damaged unit(s) in stock: check them, then record an exit if unsellable.
detail.lotsAide: The batch number traces where goods come from, sells what expires first and finds a faulty batch.
detail.aucunLot: No batch recorded for this product.
detail.confirmerEndommage: Report batch {{lot}} as damaged: enter the reason.
detail.confirmerBon: Set batch {{lot}} back to good: enter the reason.
detail.prixNonRenseigne: Purchase price not set: it is computed when you enter it on a stock entry, or set it below.
